svg.text: Skills: vi-writer · review-panel | Agents: trend-captain · fact-checker · compliance · editorial | Publish: copy-paste or Claude in Chrome | State as of 2026-11-01
• a topic or opinion: “genai is good for finance”
Domains D1 GenAI in marketing, D2 Claude/GPT
Rules: posts must agree with my opinions
Only PUBLISHED posts count for overlap
Create research/runs/YYYY-MM-DD_<input>/ + request.md · load my-views.md opinions · publish.py --published-summary (date, title, thesis of published posts)
Route the input (automatic, no question to the user)
Empty → pick domain from my-views.md (oldest ‘Last used’, priority tie-break) + its opinions → treated as TOPIC with that stance
Topic/stance → derive parent domain, focus on topic · Domain → scan whole domain · --no-trend → skip trend-captain, go to Step 2 research
Every post must agree with my-views opinions (never argue against one; evidence never misstated)
Saves: trend-scan/search-log.md · candidates.md (all scores + keep/drop reasons) · trend-report.md · sources/NN-*.md (one note per page opened)
Returns: TREND-CAPTAIN REPORT → Top 3 table · score breakdown · selected topic (angle, post type, format, lane) · STANCE / OVERLAP / VIEWS FIT checks · evidence pack
Accept #1? ≥4 sourced facts incl. a real number + a named example · dated in window · thesis ≠ any published post
No → take #2/#3 · nothing qualifies → TOPIC: research it directly · DOMAIN: ask user · ranks #2/#3 → research/backlog.md
Rules: no placeholders · every fact sourced · never invent personal experience · opinions in first person · no bait · links only in first comment · 0–2 hashtags
Self-checks on writing/draft-vN.md (one .md per version: post · hooks · changes · results)
FAIL anywhere → revise (back to Step 4); overlap fails twice → stop and tell the user which published post it collides with
Review panel (skill: review-panel · runs automatically · reports saved verbatim in review/panel-vN.md + review/review-log.md)
• extracts every claim: numbers, dates, names, quotes,
• verifies from primary sources, never the writer’s notes
VERIFIED · SECONDARY · IMPRECISE · UNSUPPORTED · FALSE → PASS / FIX / BLOCK
7 LinkedIn community policy 8 cultural sensitivity & inclusion
• safer wording for every issue · image/logo rules
BLOCK · MUST-FIX · ADVISORY · ESCALATE → PASS / FIX / ESCALATE / BLOCK
Apply fixes → next draft-vN.md · precedence: compliance > fact-checker > editorial · fixed lines become LOCKED
ESCALATE → ask the user (AskUserQuestion) · BLOCK → rebuild from VERIFIED facts · any fix → ROUND 2 in DELTA mode (changed lines only), max 2 rounds
editorial (Read) · last reviewer, the only one that rewrites
scores 1–5: hook · clarity · rhythm · audience value · voice · comment potential
edits if avg < 4.5 or any < 4 · may NOT change facts, numbers, sources, stance, LOCKED lines
skeptic read: top 3 critical comments + whether the post survives them
→ NO CHANGES / EDITED (diff table + changed claim sentences)
Stop rule: BLOCK still open after 2 rounds → post is NOT delivered; user sees the blocking issues
Top-3 trend table · post type / format / lane
hook & length · Overlap % · Views ✓ · Review panel line
alternative hooks · evidence used · editorial changes
final/post.md (+ post-v2 after review) in the run
thesis…) · run README file map · research/INDEX.md
B · Claude in Chrome (done once manually 2026-11-01 · reusable /linkedin-post skill planned)
Never: likes, comments on others, DMs, connection requests, profile changes · stop on wrong account, layout change, dialogs
After publishing: posts/<file> → status: published + URL ⇒ future runs check overlap against it (loop back to trend-captain’s −20 penalty and Step 5b).
First publication: 2026-11-01 · “The best AI score on financial modeling tasks is 57.0%…” · linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7522692657287196672
Note: automation is a gray area under LinkedIn’s User Agreement → low volume, one explicit ‘Post now’ per post, official Posts API = possible option 3
Save as you go · never overwrite · reports verbatim
• Domain input with no qualifying trend
• BLOCK still open after 2 review rounds
• Evidence that contradicts a my-views opinion
(flagged so the user can update the file)
• Publish choice A / B / C every time
• ‘Post now’ confirmation on the live preview
• Telling the skill a manual post went live (URL)
Trend window: last 3 days (7 if empty; weeks for
+≤10 views fit, −20 overlap with a published post
Hashtags 0–2 · links only in first comment
Review: max 2 rounds + editorial delta re-check
Editorial edits when avg <4.5 or any score <4
Example run: “genai is good for finance”
panel R1: fact FIX (7 issues) · compliance FIX
delta re-check: “payoff” line fixed → v7 FINAL
“gen ai for finance is bad” → fact-checker BLOCK
(benchmark v2 archived) → rebuilt on v2.1 data →
